title: KU1919_Cis_A
growth_protocol_ch1: All cell lines were grown for several passages in the absence of antibiotics, gemcitabine or cisplatin in complete media (IMDM + 10% FBS).
extract_protocol_ch1: RNA was extracted using the RNeasy Plus Kit (Qiagen). Cells were lysed and passed through QIAShredder column (Qiagen) according to the manufacturer’s protocol. gDNA elimination columns (Qiagen) were used to remove any residual gDNA from the purified RNA. | RNA library preparation was performed using the Universal Plus mRNA –Seq +UDI kit (Nugen Technologies).
data_processing: Illumina adapters were removed, along with the first 12 base pairs using BBDuk and reads <50bp after trimming were discarded. | Reads were aligned and quantified using STAR (2.6.0a) to the Ensembl human transcriptome (hg38.p12, release 96). | Lowly abundant genes were removed as those <1 mean raw count or <1 mean count per million (CPM) across the dataset. | Differential gene expression was calculated using the voom function in limma. | Genome_build: GRCh38 | Supplementary_files_format_and_content: RNAseq_ensembl_raw_counts.txt: Text file containing STAR gene count values.
contact_institute: University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus
replicate_unit: RNA collected from 3 separate passages of same derived line; not independent resistance induction
washout: several passages without antibiotics/gemcitabine/cisplatin (GSM growth protocol)
